name: NARA Summer Camp
operator_name: Athena, for the Town of Acton Recreation Department
description_short: A summer camp at NARA Park in Acton, MA, run for the town Recreation Department, for children entering grades K–6. Activities include swimming, games, creative projects and field trips.
special_needs_notes: The camp is nut-free. All physicals and immunization records must be uploaded to CampDoc.com. Paper copies are not accepted. Physicals must be from the last 18 months.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming is part of the program at NARA Park. The page gives no details about the pool or waterfront, swim tests, or lifeguards.

warnings: The page covers the 2026 season, which has ended ("2026 Acton Summer Camp is Over!"). No 2027 dates, prices or registration details are posted yet.
The page is on the Town of Acton's website. The camp itself is operated by Athena.
The page also describes a separate program, BASECAMP 01720 (grades 6–8, at the Acton Recreation Center, June 29–August 28), which is not included in this listing.
The phone number and 472 Main Street address belong to Acton Town Hall, not the camp site. The camp is held at NARA Park, but no street address is given.
The page does not say directly that this is a day camp. That is inferred from campers bringing packed lunches.
Sessions may be weekly, but the page gives only the overall season dates.
